generic_domain.justification: The term 'generalization' is the broadest and most encompassing concept, as it refers to a machine's ability to apply knowledge learned from training data to new, unseen data. This includes evaluating performance (covered under 'generalization performance'), mechanisms within models (such as in 'model generalization'), and specifically in deep learning contexts ('generalization in deep learning'). Therefore, any research domain listed can be subsumed under the broader theme of 'Generalization.'
